reviews.t: Much better than using needless aluminum foil method for soak-offs
reviews.x: Much better than using needless aluminum foil method for soak-offs.  I just stick an acetone-soaked cotton ball (half a ball, if it's a jumbo-sized ball) onto my nail and then clamp this on it, wait 5 minutes, and drag the cotton ball off with all the glitter polish.  Boom.

reviews.t: Pleasantly surprised with how easy and effective these are
reviews.x: I’ve always wrapped my nails with aluminum foil, which would keep the acetone wet. I was very skeptical when I realized these don’t keep “air-tight” so to speak, and the aluminum does. Pleasantly surprised with how easy and effective these are.

These things are worth way more than what they are sold for just based on how much easier they make your life! Stubborn nail polish, especially glitters come right off after just a short “soak” with these in place so it takes a fraction of the time since you can do them all at once without needing to pour (and waste) a big bowl of polish removed.

Amazing product! Didn't think they were going to work but they proved me wrong.  Highly recommend for gel or just regular nail polish removal.  Tip if your doing it alone it takes longer but if someone helps you put them on then its a 15 minute wait. Truly amazing little nail clips!!!!
I found these worked well with thick cotton balls as the grip on my finger was a lot tighter that way.  Definitely make sure you use a thick cotton ball with these so these are secure.
Not as easy to use as u think. Once ur first hand is "clipped" the second hand is not on ur side...  Lol but it still works.

These look and feel very dirty. They're covered in a sort of powder and there were orange/brown crumbs in the bag. In a pinch, so I'll have to wash and sanitize before using. This product has to be used previously but was not advertised as such. Gross.

This eBoot Nail Soak Off is genious! So much easier than using aluminium foil and definetly environmentally friendly, because you can reuse over and over. It's tight enough for my fingers and I don't have to worry if it's going to fall off!

I got this product for the removal of my Color Street nails.  They are so easy to use and worked just as expected.  I wish they had a little carry case so there would be less change for me to lose them but i would purchase again.
I am in love with these clips. They stayed in place and worked well. Definitely recommend.

What a great idea to use to get the gel polish or dip polish off your nails.  I started taking my own dip power off my nails before going to salon because it was taking too long for my appointment.  Now, due to the pandemic, I do my own dip power polish so they are now essential to doing my own nails and getting the prior color off.  Super easy to use, like a clothespin, and they stay in place.  I bought 2 sets and would recommend to anyone.

I wish the design could be altered so that it still had a good grip on your fingertips but didn’t squeeze so hard that it squeezes the acetone out of the cotton ball. The last few times I used these for gel removal I had them on for 15+ minutes but no gel was soaked off and the cotton balls were dried out. I like them other than that

when these arrived I noticed the bag they were in was very beat up and had some holes or scratches in it, the clips themselves look and feel dirty as well, like there is some kind of residue and smudges and smears on them. I'm just gonna wash them but its pretty gross to get what is supposed to be a new product in this condition

Using these clips makes nail polish removal so easy! I take a cotton round and put nail polish remover on it, hold it against my nail and use the clip to keep it in place. I typically leave them on for about 5 minutes and when I remove my polish comes right off. All the clips are the same size and set my fingers perfectly.

reviews.t: Really tight and allows air in.
reviews.x: These are ok, they're really tight and I have normal sized fingers. It allowed of air in, and my carton pads dried out very quickly. I was trying to avoid using aluminum foil, but after several attempts at these with soaking wet cotton pads to remove my gel polish, the cotton was dry and my gel was perfectly intact.

These clips are fantastic. I use them for regular polish instead of gel and they work wonderfully. Makes it so much faster for me to get my polish off so I can move on to the next color! I do regret getting black ones though, they’re harder to find when dropped (for me anyways)

I got tired of paying an arm and a leg for my soak off’s at the salon. These DIY Acrylic Soaks Off clips were just the trick. I didn’t need help putting them in or taking them off. I was able to function even with clips in my other fingers. Loved It!

I dislike trying to remove sns with foil. It's awkward. When I do go to a salon they file the top down and it makes my nail beds sore. These are so much easier for me to use. They are not tight and have enough pressure to keep cotton in place.

Worked well, and made removing gel polish much easier than trying to wrap foil around my own fingers. Similar items were always out of stock at the beauty supply stores so I figured waiting for delivery and saving $10 was the way to go.

reviews.t: ... as I thought they would but they still work fine. Do not try to use toilet paper
reviews.x: The grips do not hold as tight as I thought they would but they still work fine. Do not try to use toilet paper, I definitely say go to your local store and buy cotton pads that will hold up after being soaked with nail polish remover.

I think these are a great product and have a great price. The only tip i would give other people is to watch how much nail polish remover you use because it will leak out all over your hands and work area is you use too much!

These clips make it easy to soak off gel polish. There are 10 clips in the package. I am only able to use one set at a time. It is much better than soaking in a dish or wrapping in foil. I recommend them.

Pros: -cheap -help to take polish off  Cons: -DO NOT HELP TO TAKE ACRYLIC OFF -Do not work well, would rather soak my nails in acetone. -Aluminum foil works better than this. -Better options elsewhere

reviews.t: Where have you been my whole life??
reviews.x: Love!! I put the remover on a cotton ball and secured these over my nail. Within 10 minutes, the gel polish was cracked and able to peel right off. Easy to use and make removal so much easier!
This product did not work like I had hoped when I was trying to remove my nail polish. I think the old fashion way with some paper towels and nail remover would be better than this.

claims.text: Reviewers widely find these clips easier and more effective than the aluminum foil method for removing polish, especially glitter and gel.
Many users say the clips work well and hold securely in place, often removing polish in about 5 to 15 minutes.
Some reviewers note the clips are tight or let air in, causing cotton pads to dry out and gel removal to fail.
A few reviewers report the clips arrived dirty, with residue, powder, or crumbs in the packaging.
Some users mention difficulty applying them to the second hand when working alone.
